name: run_docking
description: Molecular docking simulation using AutoDock Vina to compute binding poses and affinities
usage: from app.tools.biomni.pharmacology import run_docking; result = run_docking('input/receptor.pdb', 'CC1=CC=C(C=C1)C2=CC(=NN2)C(F)(F)F', 'output/')

parameters.receptor_pdb_path: str — path to receptor PDB file
parameters.ligand_smiles: str — SMILES string of the ligand
parameters.output_dir: str — directory to write docking results (default 'output/')

returns: dict with keys: best_affinity_kcal_mol, poses (list of {affinity, rmsd_lb, rmsd_ub}), output_files
